limitations: Two newly authored public development tasks in one installed app, not private held-out launch evidence; pretraining exposure unknown
Both conditions use the same existing full-file generator, verifier and non-regressing repair selection; only prompt guidance differs
At most two native calls and 4096 requested output tokens per row; one shared 360-second generation/check deadline; actual input work and costs differ
Initial temperature 0.2; parse retry or repair temperature 0; no grammar override, enrichment, fallback or model substitution
Three repetitions per task/condition, alternating order; memory/deadline stops retain remaining planned rows
Acceptance and assistant-authored controls excluded from prompts and training exports; repair gets scoped compiler diagnostics and generic test failure only
Repair selection is not qualification; 100% tested guardrails, at least 80% adherence where scored, native and customer gates are unchanged
Seeds, actual tokens/cost, human correction time, native/device and external acceptance remain unmeasured
